messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Error in intI
parts:
Hi Gengping, sorry for the delay in response. This is an error I've seen before, and likely has to do with you trying to fit a highly complex model with lots of hinge features. Maxnet can't handle this well all the time, whereas maxent.jar sometimes can. Could you please give us specifics about what you tried to do that gave you the error? Which model did you run, what were the settings, etc.?

Jamie

Features Classes: L, LQ, H, and LQH
Regulation Multipliers: 1-5
Multiplier step value: 1
Clamping Off

Best,

Thanks for letting us know your issue. It looks that sometimes the maxnet package cannot handle the hinge feature class. As Jamie mentioned, a temporary solution is running the models using the maxent.jar option.

Best,
Gonzalo
